title: Arkret Audit RYW Receipt
description: Read-Your-Writes receipt issued by an Events API node, witness, or peer Station confirming that a ak.audit.release or other audit envelope has reached accepted state. Required by ak.profile.attested_audit.e2ee.v1 and ak.profile.disclosed_audit.e2ee.v1 before an audit applet release service may output wrapped material or plaintext evidence (see zh/crypto-media/audited-e2ee.md §6). The audit_assurance_class field MUST match the active Audit Applet Binding; mismatch fail closed.

trust_domain.description: Deployment trust domain for the Realm at the receipt frontier. Verifiers MUST require this to match the current receive context and the enclosing audit Event Realm context before using audit_policy_version_digest.

realm_operator_organization_id.description: Stable ID of the Realm operator's ultimate controlling organization at this receipt frontier. Verifiers MUST derive and verify it from the Realm service/operator DID control chain; it is not a self-attested label. For federation_witness_attested, every witness controlling_organization_id MUST be distinct from this value and from any organization under the same ultimate controller.

witness_id.description: Stable service ID of the witness that produced this receipt.

verification_method.description: DID URL of the key the witness used to sign (e.g. did:web:...#key-1). Federation-grade verification requires this value to be distinct from every other witness verification_method.

controlling_organization_id.description: Stable ID of the organization that controls the witness. This value is not self-attested: verifiers MUST resolve the DID projected from witness_id and confirm its controller / service ownership chain projects to controlling_organization_id. Federation-grade verification requires all witnesses' controlling_organization_id values to be pairwise distinct and not equal to the audit actor's controlling organization or realm_operator_organization, including common ultimate controllers.

attested_at.description: Time at which this witness attested. Receivers MAY use the latest attested_at across witnesses as the effective receipt timestamp.

witnesses.description: Externally verifiable list of witnesses attesting that audit_event_id reached accepted state. Its suite-bearing digest is decoded from audit_event_id. Verifiers derive the attestation class from this list, the accepted Realm audit policy and the verified operator control chain; producers do not declare a class on wire.

witness_attestation.description: Witness attestation block. The receipt's independence is externally verifiable from the witnesses[] list rather than self-claimed via a single enum. See zh/crypto-media/audited-e2ee.md §4.1 / §4.1.1.

audit_assurance_class.description: Audit assurance class propagated from the active Audit Applet Binding. attested_hardware = ak.profile.attested_audit.e2ee.v1 (TEE/HSM/enclave controlled release required). disclosed_policy = ak.profile.disclosed_audit.e2ee.v1 (process-only disclosure, NOT cryptographically enforced). Release services MUST propagate the binding-declared value verbatim; receivers MUST fail closed when this field disagrees with the binding/policy state at the receipt's frontier.

audit_policy_version_digest.description: Canonical hash of the Realm-bound audit release policy tuple from the receipt frontier. Computed as fixed sha256 over canonical JSON {realm_id: <id>, trust_domain: <trust_domain>, audit_binding: <object>, release_policy: <object>, release_window_policy: <object>, activation_frontier_digest: <hash>, first_auditable_epoch: <n>}. Lets verifiers atomically check that the receipt's claim matches the active binding/policy at this frontier without replaying events and prevents cross-Realm reuse or retroactive expansion of identical policy text. MUST match the receipt frontier's policy state and ak.audit.release.eligibility_proof; mismatch MUST fail closed (audit_receipt_invalidated). Required field — missing receipts MUST be rejected to prevent silent policy drift. This field is intentionally not hash-agile in v1; a future algorithm change requires a new schema/profile.

recovery_reason_code.description: Optional machine-readable code, set only when this RYW receipt covers a ak.audit.accessed Event emitted via the Late Key Recovery path (see zh/crypto-media/encryption-and-audit.md §2.3.5 and zh/crypto-media/audited-e2ee.md §4.1). Payload value, not an error-code-registry reason_code. Used by audit projections to distinguish late-key-triggered accesses from first-access reads. When absent, the receipt covers a normal (first-access) ak.audit.accessed Event.
